title: Ideal class maps on projective spaces and Grassmannians
summary: We study ideal class maps on projective spaces and Grassmannians over a number field. We prove weak approximation in every fixed ideal class fiber on positive-dimensional linear subspaces and on Grassmannians. We also introduce local defects of morphisms of projective spaces and use them to describe the ideal classes arising from the image of a linear subspace as a finite union of cosets in the class group.
